prompt:
Write 6 short claim log entries (one to three sentences each) by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim, in time order. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1309; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- Nothing suggests the damage happened before the coverage started.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text:
Entry 1: Claimant reported a left-turn collision at an intersection with a vehicle that did not yield, and stated a shoulder injury resulted. Claimant is not represented by counsel and was cooperative during the initial call.

Entry 2: Reviewed photos of the claimant's vehicle, which show front-end damage consistent with the impact described. The damage pattern lines up well with the force of a collision of this type.

Entry 3: Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle and that the other driver turned across the claimant's path. The other driver's account matches the claimant's description of how the collision occurred.

Entry 4: Claimant has given the same account of the accident in each conversation so far, with no changes to the sequence of events or the point of impact. No prior damage to the vehicle is recorded or known to the claimant.

Entry 5: Medical records show treatment for the shoulder injury has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. No earlier injury to the same body area has been identified in the claimant's history or prior claims.

Entry 6: Verified that the driver is named on the policy and that nothing indicates the vehicle damage predates the coverage start. Injury evaluation remains open pending the treating provider's updated notes.
